A NNEALED WITH OXYGEN 0.07% MAX. AND UTS 20KG/MM² (MIN)” or SIMILAR COPPER BAND with sa me specification in any Ordnance Factories/DPSUs. Firms have to mandatorily upload the Registrat ion Certificate during submission of bid. Non-registered firms have to apply for registration of the tendered item through offline mode alon g with following documents before tender opening date.

(i) Plant & Machinery details (Machine make, Installation date, Capacity/size/specification etc.) (ii) Authenticated & valid documents for out-sourcing facilities. (Tie-up/ Agreement signed by both parties sharing their resources). (iii) 'Nature of Business’ (i.e. Manufacturer/System Integrator or Selling Agents/Authorized Dealers/ Stockiest) during offline application should be mentioned properly by applicant/firm. (iv) Certified copy of Profit & Loss Statement of last 03 years. The application fee for each combined application (Consisting of Max. 20 No. of Item) for fr esh registration/Additional item registration shall be as under- a) Large Scale Industries- ₹ 10,000/- (+GST) b) Medium Scale lndustries- ₹ 5,000/- (+GST) c) Small- ₹ 3,000/- (+GST) d) Micro- ₹ 2,000/- (+GST) e) Authorised Dealers/Stockist/Sole Setting Agents- ₹ 3,000/- (+GST) f) For profile updation of registered vendor- ₹ 1,000/- (+GST).
